  ## User Story
  As a devloper I want to create a text editor that will store code snippets that I can use later and it should work on or offline.
  ## Acceptance Criteria
  Given a text editor, When I open the editor, Then I should see all code snippets I have kept in my JATE. When I choose to download this application then it is downloaded to my machine. When I disconnect from the internet the applicattion still runs locally
